title: Cork the Whine Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Cork the Whine has a prime location in Seaside, Florida in Dreamland Heights overlooking the Seaside Amphitheater and the Gulf. Enjoy incredible balcony with bar seating for two with amazing sunsets over the gulf and a king primary!
description_expanded: Description121 CENTRAL SQUARE, UNIT B41 KING, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA, sleeps 4Prime Central Square Location with Elevated Gulf ViewsWelcome to Cork the Whine, a stylish one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath vacation rental located in the heart of Seaside, Florida’s Central Square along scenic Highway 30A. Perched on the third floor of the Dreamland Heights building, this charming condo offers elevated views of the Gulf of Mexico and the vibrant town center below — placing you just steps from Seaside’s iconic white-sand beaches, boutique shopping, and beloved restaurants.Ideal for couples seeking a walkable 30A getaway, this thoughtfully designed retreat blends comfort, convenience, and coastal charm in one of Seaside’s most sought-after locations.Guests arrive at Dreamland Heights and take the elevator to the unit’s entry level. Just outside the front door, a shared open-air deck offers seating and sweeping views of Central Square and the Gulf — a perfect place to pause and take in the lively atmosphere before stepping inside.Light-Filled Living Space with Private BalconyFrom the entry level, the main living space is accessed by a ship’s ladder and narrow spiral staircase that leads to the loft-style upper level. This bright living area features soaring ceilings and expansive windows that fill the room with natural light.The inviting lounge includes a leather queen sleeper sofa and comfortable seating, creating a relaxing place to unwind after a day at the beach. A television with cable service is available for casual viewing, while sliding glass doors open to a cozy private balcony overlooking Central Square with partial Gulf views, offering a charming perch for morning coffee or evening cocktails above the town.Fully Equipped Kitchen and Dining AreaAdjacent to the living space, the fully equipped kitchen provides everything needed for easy vacation dining, from quick breakfasts before the beach to relaxed evening meals. A dining table for two sits just off the kitchen, while the breakfast bar offers seating for three, creating an open flow for gathering.Whether preparing fresh Gulf seafood or bringing home takeout from one of Seaside’s nearby restaurants, the kitchen is designed for simple and convenient coastal living.King Primary Suite with Washer & DryerThe king primary bedroom is located on the entry level of the condo and offers a peaceful retreat with large windows showcasing views of Central Square and glimpses of the Gulf. The bedroom also includes a television with cable service for guest use.Inside the bedroom closet, guests will find a stacked washer and dryer, adding convenience for longer stays or beach days.This level also includes a full hall bathroom with a single vanity and a tub/shower combination, along with a separate half bath, both located on the same level as the bedroom.Steps from Seaside Beach, Dining, and ShoppingBeach access is located at Coleman Pavilion, just a short stroll through Central Square. From Cork the Whine, you are truly in the center of it all — with more than 40 shops, restaurants, cafés, and galleries right outside your door.Spend your days biking along 30A, relaxing on Seaside’s sugar-white sand beaches, or exploring neighboring beach communities like WaterColor and Grayton Beach, all just minutes away.Whether enjoying Gulf breezes from the balcony, taking in the energy of Central Square below, or walking to dinner beneath Seaside’s twinkling lights, Cork the Whine offers a memorable stay in the heart of Seaside, Florida.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES700 square feet, located in Dreamland Heights above Seaside Central SquareSeaside Beach Access at Coleman Pavilion176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessOverlooks town & ocean with incredible Gulf viewsPrivate balconyPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued; shared permit parking located behind the Holl Building based on availability, with additional permitted parking along Quincy CircleA golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowed
